about.description:
Inspired by The Iliad – Homer’s sweeping tale of romance and bloodshed – A Total War Saga: TROY focuses on the historical flashpoint of the Trojan War, bringing the conflict to life as never before.

![Total War Saga TROY Image](https://cdn2.unrealengine.com/Diesel%2Fproductv2%2Ftotal-war-saga-troy%2Fhome%2FEGS_TotalWarSagaTROY_CREATIVEASSEMBLY_G2_00-1920x1080-f84797effd32be0dbcb1749a5fb1b720d7c8b880.jpg)

# EXPERIENCE THE TROJAN WAR

TROY explores this legendary conflict from both the Greek and Trojan perspectives, peeling back the layers of myth and legend to reveal the realities that may have inspired them.

![Total War Saga TROY Image](https://cdn2.unrealengine.com/Diesel%2Fproductv2%2Ftotal-war-saga-troy%2Fhome%2FEGS_TotalWarSagaTROY_CREATIVEASSEMBLY_G2_01-1920x1080-523f2682b9730edd12c3b5124a61f44632a736fd.jpg)

# CHOOSE YOUR HERO

Fight to save or conquer the kingdom of Troy as one of eight iconic heroes, including the infamous warrior Achilles, noble protector Hector, wayward prince Paris and vengeful king Menelaus.

![Total War Saga TROY Image](https://cdn2.unrealengine.com/Diesel%2Fproductv2%2Ftotal-war-saga-troy%2Fhome%2FEGS_TotalWarSagaTROY_CREATIVEASSEMBLY_G2_02-1920x1080-3dfbd6dd7bcdb7e4ce1af9e92eb9ea649e0c8cbf.jpg)

# BUILD A BRONZE AGE EMPIRE

Through Total War’s blend of grand, turn-based empire management and spectacular real-time battles, your actions can turn the tide of the war. Build your empire through strategy, statecraft, diplomacy and all-out war, as you conquer this vast and striking recreation of the Bronze Age Mediterranean.

![Total War Saga TROY Image](https://cdn2.unrealengine.com/Diesel%2Fproductv2%2Ftotal-war-saga-troy%2Fhome%2FEGS_TotalWarSagaTROY_CREATIVEASSEMBLY_G2_03-1920x1080-a70354d79a8ba3c47a838a7bd9a5ddfb854084a9.jpg)

# FIGHT ALONGSIDE MYTHIC UNITS

Inspired by the famed creatures of Greek myth, you can call mythic units to your aid in the heat of battle, including fighters that resemble the Minotaur, the Cyclops, Giants and Centaurs.
about.shortDescription: In this legendary age, heroes walk the earth. In an act that shocks the world, audacious Paris, prince of Troy, elopes with the beautiful queen of Sparta. As they sail away, King Menelaus curses her name. He vows to bring his wife home – whatever the cost!
about.title: DIVE INTO GREEK MYTH

about.about:
The Assembly Kit is a suite of tools that allows you to completely remodel A Total War Saga: TROY by creating new maps, units, mechanics and factions or edit those already in the game.

The Kit includes Dave for database editing, Terry for battle map creation, BoB for processing files and assembling pack files, and the Variant Editor for editing unit model collections. 

After getting your copy of TROY, simply go to your game library, install the Assembly Kit and recreate your own Bronze Age Mediterranean!

Lead two entirely new rosters of Egyptian warriors, forest ambushers, devastating chariots, Thracian highlanders and more.

# Call upon mighty Thracian gods

Safeguard ancient traditions and prove that Thracian deities are as mighty as the Greek pantheon to bolster your kingdom and forces.

Summon Countless Host armies or call on reinforcements from the sun-drenched lands of Egypt, Aethiopia, Canaan and Susa.

Assign camp followers to Memnon’s army for unique strategic effects such as inducing fatigue and disabling towers.

about.description:
Experience A Total War Saga: TROY in even more horrifying detail with the Blood & Glory DLC! This pack introduces several new gory effects to battles and the campaign map, letting your warriors charge into the Trojan War in all its blood-soaked glory.

# Campaign effects: 

- Blood-drenched event movies and pictures
- Rivers run red with the blood of warriors slain in any massive battles
- Bloodied monuments appear after large battles have been waged
- Blood effects and decapitation in combat animations

# Battle effects:

- Blood sprays on weapon impacts, staining armour, chariots and horses
- Chariots leave blood trails after trampling soldiers
- Decapitation and dismemberment on death animations
- Battles fought in rivers turn the water blood-red

Once installed, these effects can be activated through the graphics menu where you can increase or decrease the level of gore.

about.description:
# MYTH AND WAR

The battle for Troy cannot be waged by man alone. In this big, bold Expansion Pack, recruit monsters and creatures of myth to fight at your side, turning the tide of war on new fantastical battlefields and a refreshed campaign map.  Find the Cerberus – a vicious beast guarding the abyss – the Griffin – a winged master of the skies – and the Hydra – a nine-headed serpent spreading poison and madness. Harness their power and experience true myth to decide the fate of Troy once and for all.

![](https://cdn2.unrealengine.com/mythwar-1920x1080-84b26b6630ba.jpg)


# CAPTURE MYTHICAL MONSTERS 
Embark on grand expeditions in search of the Cerberus, Hydra or Griffin! Harness their powers in war, take them into Campaign and recruit their unique monstrous units.

![](https://cdn2.unrealengine.com/para-1-1920x1080-ca50c0042807.jpg)


# LEAD FANTASTIC UNITS INTO BATTLE
Conquer your enemies with the help of mythical creatures such as swift Centaurs, fiendish Harpies and the earth-shaking Cyclops. 

![](https://cdn2.unrealengine.com/para-2-1920x1080-00dd2b3a0475.jpg)

# SUPERCHARGE YOUR ARMIES WITH DIVINE POWER
Please the Gods and gain fantastical new battle abilities, such as Zeus’ Thunderbolt. 

![](https://cdn2.unrealengine.com/divine-will-1920x1080-d87058d321b3.jpg)


# EXPERIENCE THE MAGIC OF THE AEGEAN
Marvel at the beautiful environments of the Mediterranean, now steeped in myth.

![](https://cdn2.unrealengine.com/para-3-1920x1080-0ecb5ae240c9.jpg)
